_comment: Hand-kept descriptions of model files, keyed by basename without .safetensors, joined into models.jsonl by bench/build_render_dataset.py. Provenance per bench/results/2026-09-27_inventory.md and fastdude's half. origin: built here (a new file our script assembled from others), converted here (a release re-expressed for ComfyUI by our converter), or downloaded; added: the file's date on this box. Entries with a kind are listed even with no render.

minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.what: MiniMax H3 FL2VA DiT, pruned curve form, int8 convrot

minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.what: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA partition, pruned curve form, int8 convrot

fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_co.what: FastVideo FastH3 V2: full data-free DMD2 fine-tune of FL2VA, trained with VSA sparse attention, own curve basis, 50 VSA gates

minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot_fas.what: fl2va weights with FastH3's timestep conditioning set (adaln_t_table + 51 adaln projections), no gates
minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot_fas.status: deleted 2026-09-27 (hashes and rebuild: 2026-09-27_research_files_deleted.md); swap rendered on 3 scenes: lands on the base, so the conditioning is near-inert (2026-09-27_fasth3_swap.md S2)

fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_co.what: FastH3 weights and gates with fl2va's timestep conditioning set
fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_co.status: deleted 2026-09-27 (hashes and rebuild: 2026-09-27_research_files_deleted.md); swap rendered on 3 scenes: still FastH3, look and over-polish included, so they live in the weights and gates (2026-09-27_fasth3_swap.md S3, S4)

fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2_pruned_int8_co.what: FastH3 weights and gates; conditioning blended 50% base / 50% FastH3 (16-column table)
FastH3 weights and gates; conditioning blended 25% base / 75% FastH3 (16-column table)

minimax_h3_fl2va_pdd_8step_comfy.what: alibaba-pai PDD 8-step (FL2VA) for ComfyUI: backbone+refiner LoRA, adaln baked into fl2va's curve basis, 32-head output bank

minimax_h3_fl2va_fasth3temb_pdd_8step_co.what: PDD with its adaln re-baked against FastH3's time embedder and the fasth3adaln basis; loads only on minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot_fasth3adaln

minimax_h3_flashgen_4step_v1.0_768p_fl2v.what: Beidouqixing FlashGen v1.0 (data-free VSD 4-step) at full rank 64, qkv rows permuted to ComfyUI bands, adaln on fl2va's curve basis; exact on every non-adaln module

minimax_h3_flashgen_4step_v1.0_768p_ref2.what: FlashGen rank 64 refitted to the Ref2VA time basis; untested transfer (trained on FL2VA)

minimax_h3_4step_lora_flashgen_v1.0_768p.what: kijai's lossy FlashGen resize (sv_fro 0.95, average rank 13)

minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.what: H3 video VAE, fp16 (official fp32 cast down)

taeh3.what: tiny approximate H3 decoder, drafts only

qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.what: Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder cut to the 50 layers ComfyUI instantiates, int8 convrot; the shipped encoder (h3_config.ENCODER_INT8)

qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_bf16_pruned.what: The same 50-layer subset in bf16, from the official release's 14-shard text_encoder/ (layers 50-63, lm_head and final norm dropped; keys renamed so core detects it). The int8-vs-bf16 comparison's other arm

minimax_h3_ref2va_pdd_8step_comfy.what: alibaba-pai PDD 8-step (Ref2VA) for ComfyUI: backbone+refiner LoRA, adaln baked into ref2va's curve basis, 32-head output bank
